_README: HAND-EDITED FILE. This holds the manual judgement fields the auto-fetchers must not touch. Edit the 'stage' / 'tension_level' values (keep them spelled exactly as one of the items in the matching 'stages'/'levels' list) and the 'note' text, then commit. The news feeds are fetched into separate files and merged in the UI.

brasilia.note: JK/Brasília re-concession. TCU approved a variable concession-fee model; auction expected by end-2026; bundled with regional airports; operated by CAAP's Inframerica.

aa2000.note: NOT a renewal — AA2000 concession runs to 2038. Tracking the economic-equilibrium rebalancing with ORSNA and the government's buyout right.

armenia.note: Armenia–Azerbaijan peace deal initialed Aug 2025 but not yet signed. Escalation triggers to watch: June 2026 parliamentary elections, the TRIPP / Zangezur corridor arrangements, and Russia/Iran interference. Zvartnots (Yerevan) is CAAP's Armenia asset.
